usage: fleet-switchboard run [-h] [--once] [--poll POLL] [--json] [--standby]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --once       One pass, then exit
  --poll POLL  Seconds between passes (default: config poll_seconds)
  --json       With --once: print the pass report as JSON
  --standby    If another daemon holds the lock, wait for it to go instead of
               exiting (the service uses this)
